description: This file defines a REST controller for a Spring Boot application, providing basic endpoints such as welcome, documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: Rest controller handling basic endpoints for the backend service.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message when accessing the root endpoint.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to Swagger UI for API documentation.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns 'OK' indicating the health status of the application.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns basic information about the application.
